input.goal: Create index.html from scratch: a full-screen HTML5 Canvas Boids flocking simulation (separation, alignment, cohesion) with a glassmorphism HUD and controls. Single self-contained file, zero external dependencies, zero JavaScript errors.
constraints: Single file index.html with inline <style> and <script>; no external scripts, stylesheets, fonts or images.
A <canvas id="canvas"> fills the whole window (100vw x 100vh, resizes on window resize), body/canvas background #070b14, no scrollbars.
Boids rules: separation, alignment, cohesion, with max speed and edge wrap-around; each boid drawn as a bright oriented triangle visible on dark background.
Starts PAUSED with exactly 60 boids already drawn on the canvas (rendered once even while paused).

Expose window.app = { boids: Array, paused: boolean, speed: number, fps: number, frame: number, play(), pause(), toggle(), step(), reset(), addBoid(x, y) }. frame increments by 1 for each simulation update.

HUD panel id="hud" with glassmorphism style (background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2) border, border-radius 12px) positioned fixed top-left, showing: <span id="fps"> FPS value, <span id="count"> number of boids, <span id="speedValue"> current speed formatted with one decimal plus 'x' (e.g. '1.0x').
Button id="playBtn": text 'Play' when paused, 'Pause' when running; clicking toggles app.paused. Initial text is 'Play'.
Button id="stepBtn" text 'Step': advances the simulation exactly one update (app.frame += 1) and redraws, works while paused.
Button id="resetBtn" text 'Reset': recreates exactly 60 random boids, sets frame to 0, keeps current paused state.
Slider <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.5" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">: on input sets app.speed to its numeric value and updates #speedValue; speed multiplies boid movement per update.
Clicking on the canvas (mousedown/click on the canvas, not on the HUD) adds one new boid at the click position and updates #count immediately.
Use requestAnimationFrame loop; FPS is computed every ~500ms and shown in #fps even while paused.
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"#canvas"},{"exists":"#hud"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"^\\s*Play\\s*$"},{"js":"window.app && app.paused === true && app.boids.length >= 40"},{"js":"document.getElementById('count').textContent.includes(String(app.boids.length))"},{"js":"getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor === 'rgb(7, 11, 20)'"},{"js":"Math.abs(document.getElementById('canvas').getBoundingClientRect().width - innerWidth) < 2"},{"color":"#070b14","min":0.5},{"wait":500},{"expect":"static"},{"js":"(window._f0 = app.frame, true)"},{"click":"#stepBtn"},{"js":"app.frame === window._f0 + 1 && app.paused === true"},{"js":"(window._n0 = app.boids.length, true)"},{"click":"#canvas"},{"js":"app.boids.length === window._n0 + 1 && document.getElementById('count').textContent.includes(String(window._n0 + 1))"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"js":"Math.abs(app.speed - 2.5) < 1e-9 && document.getElementById('speedValue').textContent.includes('2.5')"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"Pause"},{"js":"app.paused === false"},{"wait":800},{"expect":"moving"},{"js":"app.frame > window._f0 + 5"},{"js":"Number(document.getElementById('fps').textContent) > 0"},{"click":"#resetBtn"},{"js":"app.boids.length === 60"},{"click":"#playBtn"},{"text":"#playBtn","match":"Play"},{"js":"app.paused === true"}]}

content.text: Ho creato `index.html` usando Tandem, e il browser di test (Chromium) ha superato tutti i controlli. All'avvio la simulazione è in pausa con 60 boids e il pulsante mostra Play. Step avanza di un passo, il click sul canvas aggiunge un boid, lo slider cambia la velocità e Play/Pause e Reset funzionano; il test ha verificato anche FPS e conteggio boids nell'HUD, lo sfondo `#070b14` e il canvas a tutta larghezza. Il file è unico e non usa dipendenze esterne.
